name: Factcheck-Bench
description: Factcheck-Bench is an open-domain document-level factuality benchmark with three levels of granularity (claim, sentence, document) designed to evaluate automatic fact-checking systems on their ability to verify the factual accuracy of LLM-generated responses.
reputation: Factcheck-Bench is a recent factuality benchmark that has been used in work on automatic fact-checking for LLM outputs, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes a multi-stage annotation scheme for detailed factuality labels; benchmark and code are publicly available.
